b:
^Bella: Grand-grand-mother. This time, I’m hunting you down and ending the Veilglade curse for good.

^Vella: …My dear great-grandchild, Bella… Have you learned nothing from our last, tragic encounter?

^ Once again, you come before me, foolishly intent on ending my life.

^Vella: How naive you are, my sweet child. And yet, I see you’ve brought allies with you this time…

root: ^Vella: Another misguided knight come to join the ranks within my tower.
^ Come then, child. Let me taste your blood… and delight in the desperate dreams that torment your soul.
